scientific_question: Can response-blind, hypothesis-discriminating interventions resolve BAM mechanism equivalence classes that remain after complete spatial occupancy and temporal movement evidence?
starting_evidence: Use the frozen v2.2 world definitions and the passive evidence state after positive occurrences + perfect negatives + temporal arrival evidence.

intervention_library.outcome: binary survival under direct transplant with B standardized permissive and M bypassed
binary focal persistence after partner/resource removal under standardized A/M and antagonist absent
binary focal persistence after antagonist addition under standardized A/M and partner present
first-arrival step or unreachable at a declared target under movement-only conditions with A/B standardized permissive
intervention_library.prediction_rule: use each BAM world's frozen M first_arrival_steps

selection_rule.score: partition entropy of predicted intervention outcomes
selection_rule.tie_break: intervention id then target node id lexicographic
selection_rule.repeat_until: one world remains or no intervention partitions the current compatible set

primary_hypotheses.claim: The true BAM world is never removed by correctly generated intervention outcomes.
A transplant outcome depends only on A label, partner removal only on partner-dependence bit, antagonist addition only on antagonist-exclusion bit, and movement probes only on M.
Every informative selected intervention weakly contracts the compatible-world set and no selected intervention increases it.
If two candidate worlds have distinct complete intervention signatures, the full intervention panel separates them.
Greedy truth-blind intervention selection contracts each truth case to exactly its complete-intervention signature equivalence class.

claim_boundary: Interventions are idealized known-truth probes and establish an identifiability upper bound, not field feasibility.
A/M are standardized or bypassed in B probes by design; B/M are standardized or bypassed in A probes. This deliberate intervention isolates causal axes.
Movement probes test declared M dynamics, not demographic establishment.
If complete signatures remain non-unique, do not add ad hoc probes after results; report the residual equivalence.
